title: XML Signature Wrapping authentication bypass in Moldova's MPass SAML NuGet library, fixed in 10.0.4 (CVE requested, CAN-2026-2041077)
description: An XML Signature Wrapping vulnerability in Moldova's MPass SAML NuGet library allows authentication bypass by relocating signed elements within SAML responses. This flaw affects versions 8.0.53 to 8.0.56 and 10.0.2 and was fixed in versions 10.0.4 and 10.0.5. The issue arises because the signature verification did not ensure that the signed reference matched the root element of the response, enabling attackers to authenticate as arbitrary users.
